tools.name: compare_gravel_bike_retailers
tools.description: Compare live retailer prices, available frame sizes, and in-stock status across UK shops for a specific gravel bike.

bikeModel.description: The gravel bike model to compare, e.g. "Cube Nuroad", "Marin Gestalt", "Sonder Camino", "Cannondale Topstone".

tools.name: get_discounts_and_deals
tools.description: Get all active discounts, promo codes, and partner gear deals dynamically from the Bikes and Bacon Shop.

category.description: Optional category filter matching the shop categories.

searchQuery.description: Optional search keyword, brand, or product name, e.g. "Redshift", "Loop", "Vallon", "sunglasses", "seatpost".

tools.name: get_gravel_bike_price_drops
tools.description: Get the biggest discounts, clearance deals, and price drops on UK gravel bikes across participating retailers.

limit.description: Number of deals to return (default 5, max 10).

tools.name: get_gravel_buyers_guide
tools.description: Get expert buying advice, budget comparisons, frame material breakdowns, gearing recommendations, and FAQs for UK gravel bikes.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent blog articles, bikepacking stories, and gravel gear reviews from Bikes and Bacon.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (1-10, default 5).

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the active browser tab to a specific article, guide, shop deal, or page on Bikes and Bacon.

path.description: The path to navigate to, e.g. "/gravel-bikes", "/shop", or "/latest".

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Bikes and Bacon blog posts, gravel gear reviews, bikepacking guides, and route reports by keyword, topic, or category.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "gravel tyres", "redshift stem", "bikepacking dartmoor", "tubeless sealant", "brake bleed".

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (default: 5).

tools.name: search_uk_gravel_bikes
tools.description: Search, filter, and compare 70+ gravel bikes available in the UK with live retailer stock, prices, specs, and discounts.

inStockOnly.description: Filter only bikes that are currently in stock at participating UK retailers (default true).

onSaleOnly.description: Filter only bikes currently on sale with price discounts (default false).

limit.description: Maximum number of bikes to return (default 5, max 10).

tools.name: searchSite
tools.description: Search across all articles, guides, bike reviews, and shop items on Bikes and Bacon.

tools.name: subscribeNewsletter
tools.description: Subscribe to the Bikes and Bacon newsletter for gravel cycling tips and gear discounts.
